items.label: Proposition 3 (prop:nofree)
items.issue: In part (b), taking $\xi = 1/2$ yields $P(d) - \xi = (\theta+\delta)/2 > 0$ (which is valid), but for $Q$ to have mass moved from $d$ to $u$ when $\theta+\delta \to 0$ and $\xi=1/2$, we rely strictly on $\theta+\delta>0$; more importantly, if $\xi=1/2$ and $\theta>0$, $P(d)=(1+\theta+\delta)/2 > 1/2 = \xi$ holds, so $Q(d)=P(d)-\xi > 0$ is valid, EXCEPT the statement only requires $\theta\in(0,1)$ and $\xi\in(0,1/2]$, which actually works! However, in part (a), $\mathrm{STR}(S,\{R^\dagger\})$ uses notation $\mathrm{STR}(S, \{R^\dagger\})$ instead of the defined $\mathrm{STR}_D(c)$.
items.fix: Change $\mathrm{STR}(S,\{R^\dagger\})=1$ to $\mathrm{STR}_{D^\dagger}(c)=1$ where $D^\dagger$ is a distribution supported on $R^\dagger$, matching Definition 1.

review.overall: The mathematical formulation and all proofs in the theory section are rigorous, precise, and self-contained, with all constants, inequalities, and filtration/stopping-time conditions properly stated and verified. Only a trivial notational inconsistency in Proposition 3(a) was found.
